Body.Content:
Business value

Employees and managers routinely contact HR for answers their HR system already holds — how much leave they have, what their policy allows in their location, where a request has reached. The information exists, but it is spread across separate records, so a generic answer is often wrong for the individual asking. Workforce intelligence answers those questions from the person's own worker record, plan enrolment and jurisdiction, and lets them complete the related transaction in the same conversation, so routine requests are resolved directly and HR teams can focus on work that needs judgment.

Capability details

Personal information, viewed and maintained: Employees can view their own personal details and submit updates, with the change written back through the standard governed process.

Grounded policy and HR answers: Questions are answered from the employee's own plan, grade and jurisdiction rather than a single generic policy response.

Leave entitlement and requests: Employees can ask about entitlement and balance, submit a leave request, and check the status of a request they already raised.

Manager approvals: Managers can review their pending queue and act on requests for their direct reports.

Team availability: Managers can ask about coverage across their direct reports.

Governed by design: Requests operate on a bounded context — the individual and their direct relationships — and the agent confirms an action with the user before any record is written.

Enablement

Enablement details, including administrator setup, prerequisites and rollout behavior, will be confirmed before release.

GA date: March CY2027

Preview date: February CY2026
